description: Enterprise-grade high-speed UDP data transfer platform — custom RUDP engine designed for 22–26% packet loss as the operational baseline

entities.name: UDPix
entities.description: Petabyte-scale UDP transfer platform targeting 10 Gbps+, 100ms+ latency, 22–26% packet loss tolerance as baseline

entities.name: Rust
entities.description: Primary language for memory safety and zero-cost io_uring abstractions

entities.name: Custom RUDP
entities.description: Rate-based congestion control over UDP; token bucket pacing; 1024-bit SACK bitmap; adaptive heartbeat 1–5 ms

entities.name: io_uring
entities.description: Linux async disk I/O with SQPOLL, eliminates blocking context switches for file operations

entities.name: gRPC
entities.description: Control plane transport over TCP/HTTP2 with TLS 1.3 via tonic + rustls

entities.name: AES-256-GCM
entities.description: Payload encryption for UDP data plane

entities.name: STUN/TURN/ICE
entities.description: NAT traversal stack for P2P direct transfers

entities.name: sendmmsg/recvmmsg
entities.description: Batch 64 UDP datagrams per syscall — ~250x fewer context switches vs per-datagram send/recv

entities.name: RayFile pattern
entities.description: Pack thousands of small files into 16MB virtual blocks before network transmission

entities.name: BandwidthProfiler
entities.description: Slow-start prober: 10→50→100→200→500→1000→2000 Mbps; finds goodput peak; throttles to 5 Mbps floor at >30% loss

entities.name: SackManager
entities.description: 1024-bit sliding SACK bitmap; adaptive heartbeat: 1ms at >20% loss, 3ms at 10–20%, 5ms below 10%

entities.name: TokenBucket
entities.description: Rate pacer that prevents micro-burst loss inflation on WAN links

entities.name: SegQueue
entities.description: Lock-free crossbeam retransmit priority queue; urgent (≥2 consecutive NAKs) vs normal lanes

entities.name: Packer
entities.description: RayFile-pattern bulk packer: groups (path,bytes) pairs into ≤16MB PackBlocks with binary manifest (magic UDPX, entry_count, per-file path/offset/size/part_index)

entities.name: AsyncReader
entities.description: io_uring file reader: QUEUE_DEPTH=256 SQ entries, READ_CHUNK=64KB, dedicated OS thread bridged to Tokio via crossbeam; falls back to std::fs on non-Linux

entities.name: AsyncWriter
entities.description: io_uring file writer: WRITE_QUEUE_DEPTH=128, auto-creates intermediate directories, reaps completions to keep in-flight window bounded

entities.name: ZeroCopy
entities.description: Linux splice(2) and sendfile(2) wrappers for zero-copy file-to-fd and file-to-socket paths; no-op on non-Linux

entities.name: IoEngine
entities.description: Top-level coordinator: send_directory (reader→packer→SenderCommand) and receive_files (data_rx→writer) per transfer session

entities.name: AuthEngine
entities.description: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (100k iterations, 32-byte salt) password hashing + HS256 JWT issuance/verification with zero leeway

entities.name: SessionManager
entities.description: Thread-safe session store (parking_lot RwLock<HashMap>): creates AES-256-GCM key+nonce per session, TTL-based reaper, atomic numeric_id counter

entities.name: PolicyEngine
entities.description: Bandwidth policy: default max_bps + burst_factor (1.5x), per-user overrides

entities.name: ControlService
entities.description: tonic gRPC service implementing Authenticate/Heartbeat/Terminate RPCs

entities.name: ServerBuilder
entities.description: Builds and runs tonic gRPC server: serve_insecure (dev) + serve_tls with rustls TLS 1.3 (production)

entities.name: StunClient
entities.description: RFC 5389 STUN client: Binding Request/Response, XOR-MAPPED-ADDRESS decode (IPv4+IPv6), discover_public_addr + discover_with_socket

entities.name: TurnClient
entities.description: RFC 5766 TURN client: two-round-trip Allocate, HMAC-SHA1 MESSAGE-INTEGRITY, MD5 key derivation, CreatePermission, ChannelBind, ChannelData

entities.name: IceAgent
entities.description: RFC 8445 ICE: CandidateType Host/SrFlx/Relay, priority formula 2^24*type+2^8*local+(256-id), pair formation+sorting, STUN connectivity checks

entities.name: HolePuncher
entities.description: Orchestrator: socket2 SO_REUSEPORT bind, STUN discovery, ICE checks, TURN relay fallback

entities.name: TraversalEngine
entities.description: Top-level coordinator: discover_endpoint + connect (returns Arc<UdpSocket> ready for Phase 1 data plane)

decisions.description: Use Rust as sole implementation language
decisions.rationale: Memory safety, fearless concurrency, zero-cost io_uring abstractions
TCP AIMD sawtooth fails on high-BDP WAN; token bucket maintains constant pacing

decisions.description: Separate control plane (gRPC/TCP) from data plane (UDP)
decisions.rationale: Allows independent horizontal scaling; control plane stays reliable, data plane stays fast
QUIC CPU overhead caps at ~5-10 Gbps; custom RUDP gives full rate control

decisions.description: Pack small files into 16MB virtual blocks
decisions.rationale: Avoids inode exhaustion and per-file handshake overhead for millions of small files

decisions.description: 22–26% packet loss as operational baseline, not edge case
decisions.rationale: Real WAN conditions on long-haul links; design must perform here, not just tolerate
Zero heap allocations on hot receive path — critical at high retransmit rates

decisions.description: Adaptive heartbeat SACK interval (1–5 ms based on loss EMA)
decisions.rationale: At 22% loss fast feedback loop is more important than bandwidth overhead of SACK packets

decisions.description: Phase 5 complete: unified udpix binary (server/send/receive), criterion benchmarks (rudp encode, sack bitmap, io pack), Dockerfile multi-stage + docker-compose with coturn
decisions.rationale: Makes UDPix usable end-to-end; Docker enables zero-config deployment

decisions.description: Direct mode (--direct) bypasses RUDP congestion machinery entirely — raw socket loop at line rate
decisions.rationale: LAN paths have no loss; RUDP pacing/probe overhead stalls the pipeline; raw loop is simpler and faster for zero-loss paths

decisions.description: 8-byte LE length prefix per PackBlock in direct mode wire format
decisions.rationale: RUDP delivers 1443-byte fragments, not full blocks; framing is required so receiver can reconstruct block boundaries without RUDP ordering guarantees

decisions.description: SO_RCVBUF=16MB on receiver UDP socket (kernel clips to net.core.rmem_max)
decisions.rationale: Default 208KB buffer overflows at 131 MB/s sender burst rate; 4MB rmem_max clip is sufficient for LAN burst absorption
